sources.summary: Serves as the primary source of truth for the baseline JADE fork, providing initial AST and class structures required for pipeline ingestion.
Defines command-line arguments and property file configurations required to provision main containers and peripheral nodes.
Provides XML templates required to encapsulate legacy Ant targets and bind them to standard Maven build lifecycles.
Details regex and AST transformation rules used to refactor legacy JCL or log4j imports to the SLF4J API.
Outlines dependency management rules for deploying jcl-over-slf4j.jar to intercept and redirect legacy logging calls at runtime.
